construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

City of San Jose permit H23-016 (Site Development Permit/Amendment, folder year 2023), status Approved, issue date 2023-10-11: "Site Development Permit to allow conversion of approximately 26,500 square feet of existing commercial space into 19 residential dwelling units"

The 19 units are a conversion of about 26,500 sq ft of vacant ground-floor commercial space inside Hanover Diridon, a 249-unit, seven-story apartment building at 715 W. Julian Street completed in 2021. San Jose Spotlight (Oct. 2023) reports the owner had not found a ground-floor tenant in six years.

SEC 8-K: Hines Global Income Trust acquired Hanover Diridon on 2024-01-19 for a contract purchase price of about $117.5 million (whole building, about 206,800 sq ft net rentable, 95% leased); seller not affiliated with the buyer. REBusinessOnline reports the building was rebranded Diridon West.
